## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` pass locally (CI also runs these)
- [ ] Version bumped in `app/package.json` and a `CHANGELOG.md` entry added, for user-facing changes
- [ ] Screenshots or a short clip attached, for UI changes
- [ ] CLA signed (outside contributors — the bot will ask if you haven't)
- [ ] No secrets, keys or real customer data in the diff, commit messages or screenshots
